title: No runaway work in your account
summary: If something in your account starts saving far more than usual (more than half a million changes in an hour), Trillion pauses just that work until the hour ends, tells you, and starts it again by itself. Screens that only show your things keep working.

payload.title: Runaway work pauses by itself
payload.body: If something in your account saves far more than usual in one hour, Trillion pauses that work until the hour ends and tells you here. It starts again by itself, nothing is lost, and screens that only show your things keep working. Ask your AI to change the limit if you need more.

payload.title: See the latest estimate
payload.body: Spend shows the latest usage estimates and budgets. Other work can still add usage while this kind of work is paused.
